system.description: As part of this skill you may take the leap action at no cost, gaining a +3 to your Horizontal and Vertical Leap Distance. You take no fall damage from leaping this way. You may then choose a space within 1 of the spot and come crashing down. All creatures within a magnitude 1 of the area must make an Evasion or take 2x Arcana, becoming Dropped and Stunned.
